title: Agreement Replies: So / Neither / Me too
subtitle: короткие реплики согласия и несогласия через auxiliary

ruleBlocks.text: Эта тема тренирует реактивные реплики в диалоге. Сначала ты определяешь полярность стимула (утверждение или отрицание), затем выбираешь тип реакции (согласие или возражение), и только потом подставляешь нужный auxiliary в правильном времени.

ruleBlocks.caption: Пошаговый выбор реплики
rows: I like jazz. - So do I.
I don't smoke. - Neither do I.
So has she. / Neither can we.
You didn't call. - But I did!

ruleBlocks.caption: Схема ответов
rows: Me too! / I love tea, too!
Me neither! / I didn't order it, either!
Neither did I. / Nor did I.

ruleBlocks.title: Подробные правила
lines: too и either часто стоят в конце предложения: too в утвердительных, either в отрицательных.
Обороты so / neither / nor начинают ответ, затем идет auxiliary нужного времени и подлежащее.
В отрицательных стимулах используются neither/nor, в утвердительных — so.
Чтобы возразить, auxiliary в ответе берется в противоположной форме: I miss you. — You don't! / You haven't done your homework. — But I have!

ruleBlocks.caption: Упражнение (карточка из набора)
rows: I think every child should play a sport. ~ So ___ I.
My sister doesn't like wearing skirts and neither ___ I.
Julia is revising for her History test and so ___ we.
My school doesn't have a football pitch and nor ___ yours.
Unfortunately, Pat lost a match yesterday. ~ So ___ we.
My sister doesn't watch TV at all. ~ Neither ___ mine.
My dad ___ never take up yoga and neither will my mum.
I get bored watching football matches, and so ___ my sister.
My mum can't stand techno music. ~ And neither ___ mine.
We ___ a bit slow during the match and so were the other players.
To keep fit, Dan goes for a swim every Friday and so ___ his bestie.
Diana has never let her friends down and neither ___ Bobbie.
I signed up for a computer course yesterday, and so ___ my classmate.
As a child, Olga wasn't very competitive and neither ___ her brothers.
Lucy ___ going to do a course in judo. ~ So is Miranda.
You ___ not feed the dog! ~ That's not true. I fed him!
On average, people who don't smoke are healthier than people who ___.
Those workers who ___ not eat breakfast felt more tired than those who did.
Students who studied while they were listening to music had lower scores than those who ___ not.
Emergency vehicles with lights and sirens active ___ allowed to pass through a red light.

items.en: I can't believe he's sixty. ~ I can't either.
items.ru: Не могу поверить, что ему шестьдесят. ~ Я тоже не могу.

items.en: I like milk. ~ So do I.
He left on Sunday. ~ So did she.
items.ru: Он уехал в воскресенье. ~ Она тоже.

items.en: I don't have any money. ~ Neither (Nor) do I.
items.ru: У меня нет денег. ~ У меня тоже нет.
